title: Sealed Blind Predictions for Growth-Rate Observables: Energy-Flow Cosmology vs ΛCDM
description: Pre-registered, cryptographically sealed predictions from Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) are provided for the growth-rate observable fσ8(z) and the Hubble distance ratio DH/rd(z) at z = 0.7 and z = 1.0, prior to the unblinding of DESI DR2 full-shape RSD results. The key prediction fσ8(z=0.7)=0.430 contrasts with ΛCDM’s 0.449 (≈2.0σ), with DH/rd also systematically lower than ΛCDM at both redshifts, enabling a direct, falsifiable test with forthcoming DESI DR2 data.

f_sigma8.description: Definition of the growth-rate observable: the product of the logarithmic growth rate f(z) and the rms amplitude of matter fluctuations on 8 h^{-1} Mpc scales.

growth_rate_f.description: Standard definition of the logarithmic growth rate in terms of the linear growth factor D(a).

hubble_distance_ratio.description: Hubble distance ratio used in BAO analyses, where D_H(z)=c/H(z) and r_d is the sound horizon at the drag epoch.

key_results.main_finding: EFC predicts systematically lower growth and distances than ΛCDM, with fσ8(z=0.7)=0.430 vs 0.449 (≈2.0σ) and DH/rd lower at z=0.7 and z=1.0 (2.3σ and 3.1σ separations), sealed prior to DESI DR2 unblinding.
parameters_tested: EFC coupling α (entropy-driven modification to Hubble friction in growth equation)

sealed_predictions.statement: At z = 0.7, the growth-rate observable is fσ8 = 0.430 (EFC) versus ΛCDM’s 0.449, implying ≈2.0σ lower growth under EFC.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DESI DR2 full-shape RSD measurement of fσ8 at z≈0.7; falsified if result is consistent with 0.449 (ΛCDM) within <1σ or excludes 0.430 at ≥2σ.

sealed_predictions.statement: At z = 0.7, the Hubble distance ratio is DH/rd = 19.797 (EFC) versus ΛCDM’s 20.719 (≈2.3σ lower in EFC).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DESI DR2 BAO full-shape constraints on DH/rd at z≈0.7; falsified if DH/rd agrees with ΛCDM within <1σ or jointly excludes the EFC trend toward lower values.

sealed_predictions.statement: At z = 1.0, the Hubble distance ratio is DH/rd = 16.527 (EFC) versus ΛCDM’s 17.466 (≈3.1σ lower in EFC).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DESI DR2/DR3 BAO and full-shape constraints at z≈1.0; falsified if measurements align with ΛCDM within <1σ or exclude the EFC prediction at ≥2σ.

kill_criteria: KC1: DESI DR2 full-shape RSD at z≈0.7 yields fσ8 consistent with ΛCDM’s 0.449 within <1σ, or excludes the EFC prediction fσ8=0.430 at ≥2σ.

KC2: DESI DR2 multi-tracer (LRG, ELG) analysis shows no systematic suppression of growth at z≲1 and jointly favors ΛCDM over EFC, such that the inferred EFC coupling α is consistent with 0 and excludes α<0 at ≥2σ.
KC3: DESI DR2/DR3 BAO distances at z=0.7 and z=1.0 yield DH/rd consistent with ΛCDM (20.719 and 17.466, respectively) within <1σ, jointly excluding the lower EFC values.

KC4: Independent pipeline replication of the EFC inference using the stated baseline datasets fails to reproduce the sealed predictions (e.g., mismatched fσ8 or DH/rd at the quoted redshifts) when chain hashes and configurations are verified.
